ValidationRule.description: The close date for closed won opportunities must equal today unless otherwise specified (ask admin to adjust).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordTypeId = "0121a000000Vl9I", Not( $Profile.Id = "00e1a000000lWln"), Not( CloseDate = Today()), ISPICKVAL( StageName, 'Closed Won'), ISPICKVAL( StageName, 'Closed Lost') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If you need to set a close date that is not today, contact your system administrator for help.
